faqs.question: How does drawdown work at Fintokei?
faqs.answer: Fintokei calculates maximum drawdown based on the initial balance and daily drawdown based on balance/equity at the start of the trading day depending on account type. Exceeding thresholds results in immediate failure.

seo.title: How Does Drawdown Work at Fintokei?
seo.metaDescription: Learn how maximum drawdown and daily loss limits are calculated for Fintokei trading accounts.

faqs.question: What is the payout cycle at Fintokei?
faqs.answer: Fintokei processes payout requests after an initial 14-day trading period. Subsequent payouts are eligible on a bi-weekly cycle and processed within 24 hours.

seo.title: What Is the Payout Cycle at Fintokei?
seo.metaDescription: Understand Fintokei payout frequency, first payout waiting period, and withdrawal processing times.

faqs.question: What payout methods are supported by Fintokei?
faqs.answer: Fintokei supports payouts via direct Bank Wire transfers (SEPA/Wire) and Cryptocurrency options like USDT.

seo.title: What Payout Methods Are Supported by Fintokei?
seo.metaDescription: Explore available withdrawal options at Fintokei including crypto USDT and direct bank wire transfers.

faqs.question: Is the challenge fee refunded on the first payout?
faqs.answer: Yes, Fintokei refunds the initial evaluation fee together with your first profit payout on eligible funded account programs.

seo.title: Is the Challenge Fee Refunded on First Payout?
